2338370.topic_title: 朋友的无人机掉湖里了，如何想办法帮他捞上来？
2338370.content:
在古代，人们使用一种特殊的技能来从水下取回船上掉落的物品：
首先，船上需要有两名操作人员，一名负责驾稳定的驶船只，另一名负责判断落水位置，为取得落水物做好准备。
负责驾驶船只的操作人员需要熟知附近的水文状况，能够将船只驾驶到水深较浅的区域。而负责判断落水位置的人员则需能够准确识别物体落水时的准确位置，这样才能保证成功的打捞回落水物。
具体的操作方案是这样的：判断落水位置的人将落水物掉入水中的具体位置在船玄上做好标记，然后令船只驶向潜水区。到达后，下水将徒手将物体捞起即可。
当然，由于古代科学条件不发达，这种方式不一定每次都能奏效，所以可能需要多次尝试以及一定运气。当落水物仍通过揽线与船只相连时，成功率可呈指数级上升。
==============================
当然，除此之外，作为一种成功率更高的替代方案，勤劳的中国渔民还使用“鱼网拖拽”及“通过训练过的小动物”等方式进行打捞。
希望这能帮到你。

2338963.topic_title: 朋友的无人机掉湖里了，如何想办法帮他捞上来？
2338963.content:
It is a hot summer ’ s day. A guy is flying his DJI Drone in the forest.
Guy: It ’ s very hot today. (He wipes his forehead.) But I must fly higher. My girlfriend is watching. I must show her how cool i am.
The Guy is busy flying. Suddenly, his DJI Drone was disconnected and fell into the lake.
Guy: Oh, no! My DJI Drone fell into the lake! That was my only DJI Drone! I still have to fly. What shall I do? My poor grilfriend!
The Guy sits near the lake and just stares into the lake. Then he starts to cry.
Spirit: Young man, why are you crying?
Guy: My DJI Drone fell in the lake. It was my only DJI Drone. I can ’ t get it out.
Spirit: You are crying because of an DJI Drone?
Guy: No. I am crying because of my poor girlfriend. I have to fly the drone to show my girlfriend ’ s how cool ia am, how rich i am. But without my DJI Drone, I am only a DiaoSi.
Spirit: Hmmm …… Well then, I shall find your DJI Drone. Just wait here.
The Spirit disappears into the lake for a few minutes and comes out with a shiny DJI Drone.
Spirit: Is this your DJI Drone?
Guy: No, sir. That is not my DJI Drone. That DJI Drone is made of gold.
Spirit: Are you sure? Look again!
Guy: Yes, I am very sure. That is not my DJI Drone.
Spirit: Wait again. I will be back.
The Spirit disappears into the lake again and comes back with another DJI Drone.
Spirit: Is this your DJI Drone?
Guy: No, no! that is not my DJI Drone, either. That is a silver DJI Drone. My DJI Drone is not made of silver.
Spirit: Look carefully!
Guy: My DJI Drone is made in China. That one is not mine.
Spirit: I am very sorry. This time I will get the right one. Please wait.
The Spirit disappears and comes back with an Made-In-China DJI Drone.
Spirit: Is this your DJI Drone?
Guy: Oh, yes, yes! That is mine! That is my Made-In-China DJI Drone! You have found it at last. Thank you so much. I shall always be grateful.
Spirit ： Hum …… You are an honest man and a devoted son. I shall give you all three DJI Drones. Take them and go home now. And get a room.
Guy: I will. Do not worry. And thank you again.
